name: ranger_slide_taut
description: Ranger slide with short rope — rope goes taut during slide, pulling ranger off surface. Charge WASTED. Uses S1 (L=420, shortest rope).
script: # --- Exact WB geometry: S1 at (832, 500), hook at (960,100), L=420 ---
# Shortest rope. Floor intersection is close to the hook's directly-below point.
# When the ranger slides right, the rope quickly reaches max length.
announce S1: Short rope (L=420) — grapple to ceiling
# Grapple aimed at ceiling — nearly straight up
announce Circle to SLIDE — rope will go TAUT quickly
# Slide on floor. With L=420 and hook at (960,100), the max horizontal
# distance from hook at floor level is ~128px. The ranger will quickly
# slide past this and the rope will yank them off the floor.
announce SLIDING — waiting for rope taut...
# Release Circle — should get NO boost (off surface)
announce Release Circle — charge should be WASTED
notify {SCRIPT} "Was charge wasted? (rope pulled off surface)" ["YES-WASTED","NO-GOT-BOOST","DIDN'T-SLIDE"] {inspect} blocking
